title: Q-Shape - Quantitative Shape Analyzer
description: Q-Shape 1.6.0-rc.1 is a pre-release validation candidate for browser-based Continuous Shape Measure calculations. It provides same-coordination-number comparisons, 3D visualization, and numerical report/CSV export. Engineering tests do not by themselves establish scientific parity; cite the exact Git commit used.

creators.name: Castro Silva Junior, Henrique
